name: JellyGlance overview
description: Sessions, downloads, alerts, storage, invites, and upcoming releases from JellyGlance.

displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="xs" p="xs" h="100%">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs" pr={36}>
    <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap" miw={0}>
      <Avatar src="https://jellyglance.com/project-logo.png" size={24} radius="xl" />
      <Stack gap={0} miw={0}>
        <Text fw={800} size="sm" truncate>JellyGlance</Text>
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate>{data.storage} · {data.sessionsToday} today · {data.users} users</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Box style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}><Badge variant="light" color={data.digestOk ? "teal" : "red"}>{data.digestOk ? "Clear" : String(data.digest) + " alerts"}</Badge></Box>
  </Group>
  <Stack gap="sm" flex={1} mih={0} style={{ overflowY: "auto" }}>
  <Box flex={1} mih={0} style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(max(96px, calc((100% - 12px) / 3)), 1fr))", gridAutoRows: "minmax(44px, 1fr)", gap: 6 }}>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" miw={0} style={{ justifyContent: "center", padding: "6px 10px" }}><Text size="xs" c="violet" truncate>Sessions</Text><Text fw={800} size="xl" truncate>{data.sessionsRecent}</Text></Card>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" miw={0} style={{ justifyContent: "center", padding: "6px 10px" }}><Text size="xs" c="blue" truncate>Downloads</Text><Text fw={800} size="xl" truncate>{data.downloads}</Text></Card>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" miw={0} style={{ justifyContent: "center", padding: "6px 10px" }}><Text size="xs" c="red" truncate>Alerts</Text><Text fw={800} size="xl" truncate>{data.digest}</Text></Card>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" miw={0} style={{ justifyContent: "center", padding: "6px 10px" }}><Text size="xs" c="teal" truncate>Stalled</Text><Text fw={800} size="xl" truncate>{data.stalled}</Text></Card>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" miw={0} style={{ justifyContent: "center", padding: "6px 10px" }}><Text size="xs" c="orange" truncate>Invites</Text><Text fw={800} size="xl" truncate>{data.invites}</Text></Card>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" miw={0} style={{ justifyContent: "center", padding: "6px 10px" }}><Text size="xs" c="indigo" truncate>Upcoming</Text><Text fw={800} size="xl" truncate>{data.calendarUpcoming}</Text></Card>
  </Box>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
